answers.answer_text: Can you people come to our house today to drink tea?

answers.answer_text: In your opinion, by what time can those girls reach here?

answers.answer_text: Last year my son could speak only one language.

answers.answer_text: Five years ago we could get good and cheap goods.

answers.answer_text: Perhaps all those people will be able to sit in this car.

answers.answer_text: It is hoped that everyone will be able to finish their work today.

answers.answer_text: It is hoped that all relatives will be able to come to your daughter's wedding.

answers.answer_text: I will not be able to come to your house this week.

answers.answer_text: If God wills, then all your work can be completed this month.
